text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ugah!! But I'm totally fine!! Turbo can 
still keep on running!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Amazing. Looks like Turbo-chan's 
gotten all fired up every time she runs 
lately!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm! It's enough to take your breath 
away!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Really!? Did Turbo get even more awesome!?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
It did, it really did! Turbo-chan, you've 
been working so hard! Your efforts are 
really paying off.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
It's not just about momentum; it feels 
like Turbo-chan's core has really 
solidified...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Right, it feels like my body's really 
built up! Haha. Having a Trainer around 
really makes a difference after all, huh?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo's Trainer is just as awesome as 
Turbo!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I'm not fast, but I'm full of energy!! 
I've got guts just like Turbo, and, and 
also!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
You're always smiling and so good at 
teaching!! Turbo understands right away!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
The other day, Turbo wasn't running well, 
so they taught me what to do...! And then, 
and then!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Under the warm, watchful gaze of the other 
two, Twin Turbo proudly continued to boast 
about her Trainer.
